title: centaurea incompta subsp. derventana
intro: Centaurea incompta subsp. derventana, commonly known as Mountain Cornflower, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Mountain Cornflower include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and protect against oxidative stress, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy.
